jobs.occupation: Internship in Embedded Software Development for Electricity Meters
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for software programming and are you up for new challenges? Would you like to be part of developing the future’s electricity meters for automated reading systems? Are you interested in an exciting and educational internship at an international green-tech company?

Here is what your role entails

During this internship you will become a part of a Scrum team working with embedded software for electricity meters, as well as the scripts and tools that tie the development process together. Your daily task includes improving and extending automated test software, maintaining test setups based on Raspberry Pi, and participating in proof-of-concept development projects. The specific content of the tasks will be planned together with you based on your preferences, interests, and competencies.

There is a wide range of technical disciplines, and some of the tools you might work with include:

• Python

• Programmering i C

• C#

• GIT

• Automatic software test

• DevOps

Meet your future team

As an intern in Embedded Software Development - Electricity Meters, you’ll become an integral part of our meter development department. This department designs and maintains hardware and software for our metering systems. You will join a team of 8 skilled development engineers, all with a background in firmware development and testing. Collaboration is a key focus, and close interaction with experienced colleagues provides ample opportunities for daily discussions, professional growth, and a steep learning curve during your internship.

Did you know? Our team does not just collaborate at work — we also team up on the padel court!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student interested in software development, who values quality and high reliability in our solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in electronics engineering or a related field

• Are flexible, structured, and enjoy working closely with your colleagues

• Have a can-do mindset that enables you to take on new and challenging tasks

• Are driven by a passion for developing software

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2026 until the end of June 2026.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Team lead, Jesper Kristensen on telephone nr.: (+45) 89 93 10 00.

**Do you want to play a key role in some of Denmark’s largest and most complex energy infrastructure projects? Are you an experienced planner who creates structure, transparency, and progress in complex projects? Then join us at COWI and help shape the future of sustainable energy infrastructure.

**

**Become a vital part of our Energy team

**

As a Senior Planner, you will play a key role in planning and delivering large and complex energy and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will work at Energinet as part of a COWI team supporting some of Energinet’s important projects. You will take ownership of project schedules and work closely with project managers, technical specialists, contractors and suppliers to create transparency, manage dependencies and risks, and keep projects moving forward.

Furthermore, you will support projects throughout their lifecircle – from early development and design through tendering and execution. Beyond maintaining schedules, you will function as a trusted sparring partner to project management, using planning and schedule analysis to support informed decision-making, identify challenges and drive corrective actions. Through your work at Energinet, you will gain the opportunity to contribute directly to projects that are central to Denmark’s energy infrastructure and green transition.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

**Your key responsibilities

**

As a Senior Planner, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and optimise integrated project schedules using Primavera OPC and MS Project.

• Monitor project progress together with project managers and technical leads, identify deviations and support corrective actions.

• Identify and manage critical paths, dependencies, interfaces, and schedule risks across project activities.

• Perform baseline management, what-if analyses and schedule risk assessments.

• Review and validate schedules from contractors, suppliers, and other project partners.

• Prepare clear progress and status reports, providing transparency on milestones, risks, dependencies, and deviations.

• Ensure schedules support effective progress, risk, and resource management.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of robust planning methodologies, processes, and tools across our projects.

• Provide planning expertise and constructive challenge to project management and project teams.

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**

You are an experienced and proactive planner who is comfortable taking ownership of complex project schedules. You understand that good planning is about more than maintaining a programme – you use the schedule to create transparency, challenge assumptions, identify risks and support project management in making informed decisions.

You enjoy working across disciplines and are confident engaging with project managers, technical specialists, customers, contractors, and suppliers. You bring a structured and analytical approach while being able to communicate complex information in a clear and practical way.

On top of that, you will have:

• Extensive experience in project planning and project controls, preferably from large and complex energy, infrastructure, construction, or engineering projects.

• Strong experience developing, managing, and integrating complex project schedules.

• Strong working knowledge of Primavera and MS Project. Primavera OPC experience is a requirement.

• Experience with progress monitoring, critical path analysis, baseline management, schedule risk assessments and what-if analysis.

• Experience reviewing and validating contractor and supplier schedules.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to turn complex schedule information into clear and actionable decision support.

• Excellent oral and written Danish skills.

Experience from major energy infrastructure, transmission, utilities or other large-scale construction projects in Denmark will be a strong advantage.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America, and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy, and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com or Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui at iatu@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora. We do it because it’s a part of our values and because it’s simply the right thing to do.

**Before you apply

**

All you need to include in your application is your CV - no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

As our Product Cyber Security Specialist, you will play a key role in developing, documenting, and improving cyber security processes across INVISIO. This is a broad role where you will combine specialist knowledge with internal consultancy. • Helping ensure that cyber security requirements are considered throughout the product development lifecycle

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, compliance, and management.

• Strong technical and analytical skills

• Good documentation and written communication skills

• The ability to work independently and drive tasks forward

• Good communication skills and the ability to advise stakeholders across different functions

• The Cyber Resilience Act

• Vulnerability management and vulnerability disclosure processes

• IEC 62443 or other industrial cyber security standards

• Product security or embedded systems security

• Risk assessment methods and cyber security compliance

• Security documentation for regulated products or systems

• A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role.

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international, high-tech environment.

• Opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

• A culture built on passion, innovation, working as one team and putting the customer first.

• A flexible working environment, primarily based at our headquarters in Hvidovre, Copenhagen, with the possibility of working from home when appropriate.

Join us in building the foundation of next generation hearing device platforms.

_Are you passionate about firmware close to the metal? Do you enjoy understanding how hardware really works and applying your expertise to build stable, efficient real time embedded systems? Would you like your work to make a real difference for millions of people living with hearing loss worldwide?

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

About The Team

You will join our Foundation Firmware area within the R&D Device SW organization — a group of about 25 highly skilled engineers working in three scrum teams. Together we build and maintain the low level firmware that forms the foundation of all Demant hearing device software platforms.

We work closely with hardware, software and production teams throughout every stage of platform development. The atmosphere in the team is informal, friendly, and highly engaged. We believe the best results come from a fruitful team effort. We support each other, provide constructive feedback, and share knowledge and ideas to continuously improve our solutions and reach common goals.

What You Will Be Working On

Our work spans the full development flow of a resource-constrained platform — from IC specification and early bring-up, through development, verification, and production, all the way to product release. This means working in simulations, on FPGA prototypes, and on real silicon as our platforms mature. Our chipsets are internally developed, multi-core network-on-chip solutions designed for ultra-low-power audio. Our firmware platform includes hardware drivers and HAL, RTOS integration, power management, file handling, communication stacks, security, firmware update functionality and more.

You will design, develop, test, and release firmware for our custom ICs, working closely with other embedded software, hardware, production, and verification teams. Your focus will be on delivering advanced functionality with real-time guarantees for the system, while always balancing memory consumption, compute cycles, and power efficiency to meet the high standards of medical devices. This means writing safe, efficient C code that enables our hearing devices to perform reliably in highly resource-constrained environments. You will use and help improve specialized in-house tools that assist the development process, as well as automated regression tests that safeguard stability and performance of our platform as it evolves.

In summary, your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, develop and test efficient firmware for our chipset platform

• 
Support hardware and production teams in bring up, calibration and verification

• 
Contribute to the definition and development of our internally developed ICs

• 
Implement safe and efficient C code for real time applications

• 
Help ensure high quality through automated tests and CI/CD

• 
Participate in team ceremonies and knowledge sharing

What You Bring

You hold a degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar, and you have a solid hands-on experience – at least 3 years – within the following areas of embedded SW development:

• 
Embedded C programming for memory , power and time constrained systems

• 
Understanding of processor architectures and MCUs

• 
Real time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time handling of HW

• 
Reading HW schematics

• 
Working with measurement instruments such as logic analyzers or oscilloscopes

• 
Automated unit and system testing

• 
Version control systems (git)

• 
Linux, scripting and custom toolchains

You take pride in building high-quality, maintainable code and are comfortable working in large, shared code repositories with comprehensive testing and a complex build flow. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating within the team and across teams to achieve the best results.

Why Demant?

At Demant, we believe in balancing professional passion with a fulfilling personal life. Our flexible hybrid work model allows you to work from home up to two days per week. Each morning, you can enjoy complimentary breakfast, and lunch is provided daily in our canteen. To support your well-being, you will have access to fitness facilities, weekly training sessions, and massage services. If you are parent, we offer attractive parental benefits, including the option to stay home when your young child is unwell. Above all, we prioritize a respectful and inclusive workplace culture where colleagues support one another, and everyone feels valued.

How To Apply

This is a full time position located at our headquarters in Smørum, Greater Copenhagen area. (Please note: We are not considering part time, consultant, or internship contracts for this role.)

Please submit your CV and a short motivation via our online portal no later than October 30th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Maja Lončar, Senior Manager System Firmware, at mjln@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in weeks 44-45 and second-round interviews in weeks 45-46.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Job Title: IT Compliance Advisor (Specialist) for Digital workplace solutions

Department: Infrastructure Projects, Quality and Service Management (IPQS), Enterprise IT & Quality

As IT Compliance Advisor, you will help the teams behind Novo’s global digital workplace deliver at speed without compromising on quality. In this new role, you will turn complex regulatory requirements into practical steps for teams running devices, M365, meeting rooms and other services that nearly 70,000 colleagues rely on every day. Are you experienced in virology and downstream purification, and motivated to apply your expertise to virus safety? Join our CMC Virus Safety team, where you will take independent ownership, quickly build new knowledge and combine hands-on experimental work with scientific advisory and project coordination. Apply today and help shape the virus safety strategies behind tomorrow’s therapeutic products

What you’ll do

As an Advanced Development Scientist in the Virus Safety team, you will work with experts across the Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC) Drug Development organisation to develop and manage virus safety strategies for Drug Substance projects. You will advise stakeholders, contribute to cross-disciplinary project teams and coordinate activities that ensure the virus safety of mammalian-expressed products in development.

A central part of the role is planning, executing and analysing downscaled downstream purification experiments. Your work will support the development of robust purification processes that remove and/or inactivate viruses. The position also provides strong opportunities to develop your scientific expertise and project management capabilities.

Your key responsibilities:

• Plan and conduct virus clearance evaluation studies using downscaled purification processes.

• Plan, evaluate and report experimental laboratory work.

• Provide data and scientific input to purification process development.

• Collaborate closely with laboratory technicians, including troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring the delivery of high-quality project results.

• Contribute to scientific writing, including documentation for clinical trial applications.

• Coordinate virus safety activities for mammalian-expressed products in development.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we expect that you hold at least an M.Sc. in chemical engineering, biochemistry or another relevant discipline. You also bring:

• Have experience with downstream purification process steps, such as chromatography and filtration, for example using an ÄKTA chromatography system.

• Communicate effectively and collaborate confidently with stakeholders across functions and organisational areas.

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Relevant industry experience or a PhD.

• Experience from a GMP-regulated area.

• Knowledge of molecular detection techniques such as qPCR or RT-qPCR.

As a person, you are proactive, self-driven and comfortable taking independent ownership of your work. You learn quickly, seek out the knowledge needed to move tasks forward and apply new insights in practice. With a practical and solution-oriented mindset, you stay focused and adapt effectively when priorities or challenges change. You also enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge and contributing to strong results with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation.

Who you’ll work with

The Virus Safety team is part of the CMC Development organisation, which brings new therapeutic products into clinical trials. Based at our Gentofte site, the team assures the viral safety of API processes and biopharmaceutical products.

Our work is grounded in a strong scientific approach and carried out in multidisciplinary project groups. We collaborate closely with analytical and process development colleagues as well as international production facilities. The environment is dynamic and fast-changing, making curiosity, adaptability and a can-do attitude essential.

jobs.occupation: Sr. Director, Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead world-class expertise at the front of differentiating peptide and protein drug discovery? Do you want to impact the drug discovery strategy that helps new candidates move faster, more reliably and with stronger scientific confidence towards first human dose?

If so, this is a unique opportunity to advance molecular expression, bioanalysis and ADME science, accelerate drug innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases, and champion technological innovation and collaboration across boundaries to deliver exceptional performance across discovery and development.

**The Position

**As Sr. Director for Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME, you will lead two centres of excellence and set the direction for the area that enables novel peptide and protein candidates to move quickly and reliably towards first human dose (FHD). Your leadership will enhance molecular expression, PK and ADME science, safeguard critical timelines and strengthen the competitiveness of the discovery portfolio.

You will provide senior leadership for the Centre for Expression Engineering and the Centre for Bioanalysis & ADME, shaping strategy and delivery across the area. You will partner closely with Research Centres of Excellence (RCE), Therapeutic Discovery, Chemistry Manufacturing and Control (CMC), Global Research, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS), CROs and academic and biotech collaborators to keep projects progressing with clarity, quality and speed.

You will lead a team of Department Managers and Scientific Directors and, together with them, guide a high-performing, purpose-driven team of around 80 colleagues in total. As a member of the RCE leadership team, you will help move decisions forward and shaping the culture, represent the area in steering committees and sponsor initiatives that improve business outcomes and collaboration.

Location: Måløv, Denmark.

**What You’ll Do

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Inspire and empower department managers and teams through visionary leadership and meaningful mentorship, nurturing talent and creating opportunities for people to grow, thrive and succeed together.

• Build a high-capability, high-performance, challenge-safe and collaborative culture through role-modelling, talent development, succession planning and continuous efficiency improvements.

• Identify and sponsor cross-organisational initiatives that improve business outcomes, collaboration and research impact.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role in pharmaceutical drug discovery. To succeed, you will bring:

• A PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech research, including drug discovery and preclinical development.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Strong collaborative leadership, enterprise and pragmatic mindset and the ability to build partnerships across disciplines and with external partners.

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to optimise discovery and development.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Given the strong scientific expertise already embedded across the organization, direct experience in all technical disciplines is not essential. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.

The work moves at pace, combining scientific ambition with a strong performance culture where your contribution is recognised.

You will be part of a collaborative high-performing leadership team where people keep things informal, find creative solutions together and have fun along the way.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the science that gets competitive new drug candidates to patients faster, apply for the Sr. Director, EEBA role by 22 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
